new_page.h1: The Semiah Condos for Sale, White Rock

faq.a: The Semiah at 1439 George Street (project address 15241 Thrift Avenue) was built 2021 by Marcon, per the MLS® strata building record.
The Semiah is 14 storeys with 88 apartments.

faq.q: What amenities does The Semiah have?
faq.a: Central air conditioning, a ground-floor fitness room, bike storage, a playground and a storage locker for each home.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Building facts from the City of White Rock info sheets and the MLS® strata building records, read November 14, 2026. Live search: Gerry’s 1452099.

The Semiah is a 14-storey concrete tower with 88 homes on George Street in White Rock’s Town Centre, built by Marcon in 2021 and designed by Arno Matis Architecture. It is residential only, with no shops below.
